DEFINE INSTRUMENT Powder_Diffractometer(lambda=2.5666, R=0.87, R_curve=0.87, filename="Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz", D_PHI=6, SHIFT=0, PACK=0.7, Dw=0.8, BARNS=1, SPLITS=58)
DECLARE
%{
  double mono_q = 1.8734;
  double y_mono = 0.025;
  int NV = 5;
  double sample_radius = 0.008/2;
  double sample_height = 0.03;
  double can_radius = 0.0083/2;
  double can_height = 0.0303;
  double can_thick = 0.00015;
  double Qc = 0.0217;
  double R0 = 0.995;
  double Mvalue = 1.9;
  double W = 1.0/250.0;
  double Qc_curve = 0.0217;
  double R0_curve = 0.995;
  double Mvalue_curve = 2.1;
  double W_curve = 1.0/250.0;
  double ldiff = 0.05;
  double TTM, OMA, RV, angleGuideCurved, alpha, alpha_curve;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  TTM = 2*asin(mono_q*lambda/(4*M_PI))*RAD2DEG;
  OMA = TTM/2;
  RV = fabs(2*2.82*sin(DEG2RAD*OMA));
  angleGuideCurved = -2.0*asin(0.4995 /2.0/3612)/M_PI*180;
  alpha = (R0-R)/Qc/(Mvalue-1);
  alpha_curve = (R0_curve-R_curve)/Qc_curve/(Mvalue_curve-1);
%}

TRACE
COMPONENT source_arm = Progress_bar(AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE)
COMPONENT source = Source_Maxwell_3(AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE source_arm)
  PARAMETERS yheight = 0.156, xwidth = 0.126, Lmin = lambda-ldiff/2, Lmax = lambda+ldiff/2, dist = 1.725, focus_xw = 0.02, focus_yh = 0.12, T1 = 296.16, T2 = 40.68, I1 = 8.5E11, I2 = 5.2E11
COMPONENT PSDbefore_guides = PSD_monitor(AT [0, 0, 1.49999] RELATIVE source_arm)
  PARAMETERS nx = 128, ny = 128, filename = "PSDbefore_guides.dat", xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT l_mon_source = L_monitor(AT [0, 0, 1e-9] RELATIVE PSDbefore_guides)
  PARAMETERS nL = 101, filename = "lmonsource.dat", xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, Lmin = 0, Lmax = 20, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT guide1 = Guide(AT [0, 0, 1.50] RELATIVE source_arm)
  PARAMETERS w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12, w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12, l = 4.66, R0 = R0, Qc = Qc, alpha = alpha, m = 1.8, W = W
COMPONENT PSDbefore_curve = PSD_monitor(AT [0, 0, 4.664] RELATIVE guide1)
  PARAMETERS nx = 128, ny = 128, filename = "PSDbefore_curve.dat", xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT guide2 = Bender(AT [0, 0, 4.69] RELATIVE guide1)
  PARAMETERS w = 0.02, h = 0.12, r = 3612, l = 20, R0a = R0_curve, Qca = Qc_curve, alphaa = alpha_curve, ma = Mvalue_curve, Wa = W_curve, R0i = R0_curve, Qci = Qc_curve, alphai = alpha_curve, mi = 1, Wi = W_curve, R0s = R0_curve, Qcs = Qc_curve, alphas = alpha_curve, ms = Mvalue_curve, Ws = W_curve
COMPONENT PSDafter_curve = PSD_monitor(AT [0, 0, 20.0001] RELATIVE guide2)
  PARAMETERS nx = 128, ny = 128, filename = "PSDafter_curve.dat", xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT bunker = Guide(AT [0, 0, 20.1502] RELATIVE guide2)
  PARAMETERS w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12, w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12, l = 3.43, R0 = R0, Qc = Qc, alpha = alpha, m = 1.6, W = W
COMPONENT guide3 = Guide(AT [0, 0, 3.56] RELATIVE bunker)
  PARAMETERS w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12, w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12, l = 12.275, R0 = R0, Qc = Qc, alpha = alpha, m = 1.6, W = W
COMPONENT guide4 = Guide(AT [0, 0, 15.8555] RELATIVE guide3)
  PARAMETERS w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12, w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12, l = 5.66, R0 = R0, Qc = Qc, alpha = alpha, m = 1.6, W = W
COMPONENT window1 = Al_window(AT [0, 0, 5.66+1e-9] RELATIVE guide4)
  PARAMETERS thickness = 0.002
COMPONENT ydist_fluxpos = PSDlin_monitor(AT [0, 0, 5.66+1e-8+0.01] RELATIVE guide4 ROTATED [0, 0, 90])
  PARAMETERS nbins = 11, filename = "ydist_fluxpos.dat", xwidth = 0.120, yheight = 0.02, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT PSD_fluxpos = PSD_monitor(AT [0, 0, 5.66+1e-7+0.01] RELATIVE window1)
  PARAMETERS nx = 100, ny = 100, filename = "xdist_fluxposy.dat", xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT xdist_flux_pos = PSDlin_monitor(AT [0, 0, 1e-9] RELATIVE PSD_fluxpos)
  PARAMETERS nbins = 11, filename = "xdist_fluxpos.dat", xwidth = 0.020, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT PSD_fluxposB = PSD_monitor(AT [0, 0, 6.24-1e-7-0.01] RELATIVE guide4)
  PARAMETERS nx = 100, ny = 100, filename = "PSD_fluxposB.dat", xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT window2 = Al_window(AT [0, 0, 1e-9] RELATIVE PSD_fluxposB)
  PARAMETERS thickness = 0.002
COMPONENT in_slit = Slit(AT [0, 0, 0.0021] RELATIVE window2)
  PARAMETERS xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06
COMPONENT lambda_in = L_monitor(AT [0, 0, 0.001] RELATIVE in_slit)
  PARAMETERS nL = 128, filename = "L_in.dat", xmin = -0.011, xmax = 0.011, ymin = -0.061, ymax = 0.061, Lmin = 0, Lmax = 2*lambda, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT sma = Arm(AT [0, 0, 0.65] RELATIVE in_slit ROTATED [0, OMA, 0])
COMPONENT foc_mono = Monochromator_2foc(AT [0, y_mono, 0] RELATIVE sma SPLIT SPLITS)
  PARAMETERS zwidth = 0.05, yheight = 2*y_mono, gap = 0.0005, NH = 1, NV = NV, mosaich = 38, mosaicv = 38, r0 = 0.7, Q = mono_q, RV = RV, RH = 0
COMPONENT msa = Arm(AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sma ROTATED [0, TTM, 0] RELATIVE in_slit)
COMPONENT out1_slit = Slit(AT [0, 0, 0.2] RELATIVE msa)
  PARAMETERS xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06
COMPONENT Amoin_slit = Slit(AT [0, 0, 0.325] RELATIVE msa)
  PARAMETERS xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06
COMPONENT Bmoin_slit = Slit(AT [0, 0, 0.525] RELATIVE msa)
  PARAMETERS xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06
COMPONENT out2_slit = Slit(AT [0, 0, 0.65] RELATIVE msa)
  PARAMETERS xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06
COMPONENT PSD_sample = PSD_monitor(AT [0, 0, 2.77] RELATIVE msa)
  PARAMETERS nx = 80, ny = 80, filename = "PSD_sample.dat", xmin = -0.05, xmax = 0.05, ymin = -0.07, ymax = 0.07, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT lambda_sample = L_monitor(AT [0, 0, 2.81] RELATIVE msa)
  PARAMETERS nL = 128, filename = "L_sample.dat", xmin = -sample_radius, xmax = sample_radius, ymin = -sample_height/2, ymax = sample_height/2, Lmin = lambda-0.2, Lmax = lambda+0.2, restore_neutron = 1
COMPONENT sa_arm = Arm(AT [0, 0, 2.82] RELATIVE msa)
COMPONENT sample = PowderN(AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sa_arm)
  PARAMETERS reflections = filename, radius = sample_radius, yheight = sample_height, pack = PACK, p_inc = 0, p_transmit = 0, DW = Dw, d_phi = D_PHI, barns = BARNS
COMPONENT STOP = Beamstop(AT [0, 0, 1.4] RELATIVE sa_arm)
  PARAMETERS radius = 0.3
COMPONENT Detector = Monitor_nD(AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sa_arm ROTATED [0, 0, 180] RELATIVE sa_arm)
  PARAMETERS xwidth = 3.0, yheight = 0.09, bins = 400, min = 19.9+SHIFT, max = 99.9+SHIFT, options = "banana,theta", filename = "detector.dat"

END
